html:
G'oya

Har bir mahsulot uchun ikki qiymat kerak: eng erta sanadagi narx va eng kech sanadagi narx. Ikkalasini korrelyatsiyalangan skalyar subquery topadi: shu mahsulotning yozuvlarini sana bo'yicha saralab, birinchisini oladi. Oxirgi narx uchun xuddi shunday, faqat DESC.

Yechim

WITH p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_id,
    (SELECT price FROM price_history a
     WHERE a.product_id = h.product_id
     ORDER BY change_date LIMIT 1) AS first_price,
    (SELECT price FROM price_history b
     WHERE b.product_id = h.product_id
     ORDER BY change_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_price
  FROM price_history h
)
SELECT product_id, first_price, last_price
FROM p
WHERE last_price > first_price

DISTINCT kerak, chunki tashqi FROM price_history har bir yozuv uchun bitta qator beradi va uch yozuvli mahsulot uch marta chiqardi. Bitta yozuvli mahsulotda ikkala subquery bir xil narxni topadi va > uni o'tkazmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

MIN(price) va MAX(price) narx qachon bo'lganini bilmaydi. Namunada 2-mahsulot 50 000 dan 45 000 ga arzonlagan, lekin MAX > MIN uni narxi oshganlar qatoriga qo'shadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT product_id, MIN(price) AS first_price, MAX(price) AS last_price
FROM price_history
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING MAX(price) > MIN(price)

Oraliqdagi eng katta narx bilan solishtirish ham xato. Narx 10 000 dan 15 000 ga chiqib, keyin 9 000 ga tushgan bo'lsa, oxirgi narx birinchisidan past.

Yozuvlar jadvalga qanday tartibda kiritilganiga tayanmang. Birinchi va oxirgi narxni faqat ORDER BY change_date aniqlaydi.

Boshqa yo'l

Avval har mahsulotning birinchi va oxirgi sanasini MIN / MAX bilan topib, keyin narxlarni shu sanalar bo'yicha qayta ulash. (product_id, change_date) birlamchi kalit, shuning uchun har bir ulanish aynan bitta qator topadi:

SELECT f.product_id, f.price AS first_price, l.price AS last_price
FROM (
  SELECT product_id, MIN(change_date) AS d1, MAX(change_date) AS d2
  FROM price_history
  GROUP BY product_id
) m
JOIN price_history f ON f.product_id = m.product_id AND f.change_date = m.d1
JOIN price_history l ON l.product_id = m.product_id AND l.change_date = m.d2
WHERE l.price > f.price
